alerts.title: Water today: a turn was missed
alerts.why: Wheat is tillering. Soil at 71%, above the 50% refill point. No rain in the forecast.
steps: Water today or tomorrow, early morning.
Make sure water reaches the north-east corner.
alerts.voice: فاتك دور مية. اسقي النهارده لو تقدر.

alerts.title: Little rust weather this week
alerts.why: 0 of the last 7 nights were foggy and humid. Nights 12 to 17 °C. Your variety resists rust well.
steps: From January, walk the field once a week.
alerts.source: Rust weather index, NASA POWER and Open-Meteo humidity and dew point

alerts.title: New satellite image: the north-east corner looks weaker
alerts.why: The north-east corner is 16% less green than the rest, two images in a row.
alerts.voice: فيه حتة في الأرض أضعف من الباقي. روح بص عليها.

alerts.title: Weeded on 11 Nov. Keep an eye out until 26 November
alerts.why: Weeks 3 to 6 after sowing are the critical weed-free period for wheat sown 15 Oct.
steps: Weed again only if new weeds come up.
alerts.voice: إنت نضّفت الحشايش. خلّي عينك على الأرض لحد يوم 26.

alerts.title: No heat risk this week
alerts.why: Highs of 23 to 29 °C. Wheat is not yet at a heat sensitive stage.
